action.prompt: You just saved a source file. Update the matching spec's tasks.md under .kiro/specs/ so the checkbox state reflects what actually changed: mark completed tasks [x] only when their tests pass, and add a follow-up task if the change revealed new work. Do not mark tasks done on the basis of code existing — only on verified behavior.

hooks.description: Keep spec task checklists honest after every source change.
hooks.name: Sync spec tasks on save
